text: You just created your user id mei_patel_7272 and ordered some things, but realized you might have typed your address wrong. You want to check it, and potentially correct all order addresses and your user address. After this, you'd like to check the jigsaw you ordered, and if it's not shipped yet, you want to change it to the easiest jigsaw (easiest level, least pieces) because your kid is too young. By default you use PayPal.
zh: 你刚刚创建了用户 ID mei_patel_7272 并订购了一些东西，但意识到你可能把地址输错了。你想检查一下，并可能更正所有订单地址和你的用户地址。之后，你想检查一下你订购的拼图，如果还没发货，你想把它换成最简单的拼图（难度最低，块数最少），因为你的孩子太小了。默认使用 PayPal 支付。(#W1234567, #P7890123, 拼图)
